pages.title: One Step Beyond
pages.text: Apply a late enchantment through its real function.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: This is the End-cooking expansion’s enchantment, not a similarly named armor-set effect. Check its supported item and native rules; Void Assault and Void Echo are separate combat effects.

pages.title: Use End food effects
pages.text: Dream, Mint and Void Erosion are different effects: air movement, protection against magic and Enderman stares, or distinct combat behavior. Do not replace them with an invented universal quality effect.

pages.title: Enchant for void exploration
pages.text: Void Walker is a separate enchantment requiring supported equipment. Void Assault and Void Echo trigger combat effects; the installed version determines their exact chances and levels.
